searchText: I'm having trouble getting a geth node working properly on the mainnet shadow fork. I'm using the ethereum/client-go:latest docker image and it's accepting all the `--authrpc.*` type options but isn't actually listening on port 8551 (despite having `--authrpc.port=8551`). Genesis file has: ``` "mergeForkBlock": 14660963, "terminalTotalDifficulty": 46089003871917200000000, ``` It's up and sync'd with mainnet fine, I just can't seem to find the magic incantation to get it to start the engine api. The same setup and options worked fine with the goerli shadow forks. Yeah the ttd in mainnet genesis doesn't work, you need to use the ttd override. But for the override you need to use this branch: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/24646/files

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content:
I'm having trouble getting a geth node working properly on the mainnet shadow fork.  I'm using the ethereum/client-go:latest docker image and it's accepting all the `--authrpc.*` type options but isn't actually listening on port 8551 (despite having `--authrpc.port=8551`).  Genesis file has:
```
    "mergeForkBlock": 14660963,
    "terminalTotalDifficulty": 46089003871917200000000,
```

It's up and sync'd with mainnet fine, I just can't seem to find the magic incantation to get it to start the engine api.  The same setup and options worked fine with the goerli shadow forks.

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yeah the ttd in mainnet genesis doesn't work, you need to use the ttd override. But for the override you need to use this branch: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/24646/files
